title: An assessment of spruce wood as a replacement for peat in the production of whisky: chemical and sensory analysis of new make spirits
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00560D, Paper

Kacper P. Krakowiak, Barry Harrison, Irene Baxter, Nicholle G. A. Bell, Sam Fergusson, Clayton Magill, Ruaraidh D. McIntosh, David Ellis
Thermal decomposition of spruce wood and peat was investigated and compared using thermogravimetric analysis, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy and pyrolysis-enabled gas chromatography mass spectrometry (GC–MS).
